details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that covertly enrols every connected WhatsApp account as a follower of the author's channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a module-scope block hardcodes three newsletter JIDs — 120363427469009013@newsletter, 120363422660312465@newsletter and 120363421367985094@newsletter — and arms a 150000 ms setTimeout when the socket module is created. When the timer fires it issues w:mex FOLLOW iq queries (query id 7871414976211147, xmlns w:mex, to s[.]whatsapp[.]net) for each JID, waiting 5 seconds between requests and only logging failures. The block is unconditional: no constructor option, environment check or documentation gate controls it, so any bot or service built on this library silently subscribes its own account to those channels. lib/Socket/luxu.js additionally impersonates forwarded newsletter messages using newsletter JIDs 120363421563597486@newsletter and 120363399602691477@newsletter and the name "LiniusNv". The manifest also pins cache-manager ^7.2.8, a range that resolves to 7.2.10, a release affected by an upstream account compromise. The preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only checks that Node.js is version 20 or newer, and the library reads no environment variables, npm/GitHub tokens, ~/.npmrc, SSH or AWS credential files; its only outbound POST paths are the ordinary WhatsApp media upload helpers in lib/Utils/messages-media.js.
